headword: {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}

definitions.gloss: collective responsibility; joint liability; shared responsibility
definitions.explanation: The principle that all members of a group share responsibility for the actions of any individual member. Used both as a legal term (joint liability) and in everyday contexts (group punishment or shared blame).

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}だ。
examples.english: It's the collective responsibility of the whole team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}らされた。
examples.english: The entire department was held collectively responsible for one person's mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{叱|しか}られる→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At school, when one person does something wrong, the whole class is sometimes scolded as a matter of collective responsibility.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{連帯|れんたい}→連帯：14425_rentai⟧ (solidarity, joint) and ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (responsibility). This concept is deeply embedded in Japanese group culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take collective responsibility)
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to bear joint liability)
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ (to hold collectively responsible)
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}らされる (to be made to take collective responsibility)

In legal contexts, ⟦{連帯|れんたい}→連帯：14425_rentai⟧⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧ (joint and several obligation) is the formal equivalent. In everyday Japanese, the concept is frequently encountered in schools, sports teams, and workplaces, where a group may be punished for the actions of one member.
